newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan to publish prelim June CPI data on June 20.
newsitem.headline: Milan to publish prelim June CPI data on June 20.

text.p: The Italian city of Milan will publish its preliminary June consumer price index (CPI) inflation data at 1530 GMT on Friday June 20, the city's press office said.
In May, Milan posted a 0.2 percent monthly rise for a 1.6 percent year-on-year increase, compared to a national rise of 0.3 percent month-on-month and an annual rate of 1.6 percent.
Milan is one of 11 Italian cities which publish their inflation data. The city's CPI has a weighing of 19.1 percent on the total national index.
The official national CPI figures will be published on July 4.
